Alice: Quick idea  run a tiny micro-launch: 200 free credits + two prompt packs + a 20-min workshop to test signup -> first 3 queries lift.

Ben: Cohort 300, A/B split. A gets workshop invite + credits + templates; B gets credits + templates only.

Cass: Prompt packs = 'hack-kit' and 'pitch-email'. I'll upload social + landing assets to Drive by EOD.

Dev: Routing plan: add utm params per influencer, set signup metadata `seed_cohort`, skip full product tour and surface templates modal with "Run sample" CTA.

Emma: Metrics: baseline signup->3queries ~17%. With credits+templates I model ~24%. I'll wire a dashboard for cohort funnels and 7d retention.

Alice: Timeline: routing & credit issuance live Tue 09:00 PT, posts Tue 10:00 PT, workshop Tue 16:00 PT. Need gating: email verify before claim.

deploy-bot: Created calendar event "Ignite micro-workshop" Tue 16:00 PT  invites sent to #marketing.

Ben: Ops: if spam spikes pause credit issuance and require manual whitelist for influencer links.

Alice: Action items assigned. Quick check-in tomorrow 10:00 PT. :rocket:
